name: Plugin Demo
description: A demo plugin for trying out validator plugins: one check per finding status, a check that's off by default, and sample books that trigger each one.

checks.name: Demo error marker
checks.description: Reports an error wherever a file contains the text PLUGIN-DEMO-ERROR, so you can see how an error looks and rolls up.

checks.name: Leftover TODO markers
checks.description: Flags TODO, FIXME, and TK markers left in XHTML content, with the line they're on.

checks.name: Cover image declared
checks.description: Passes when a manifest item has properties="cover-image", and warns when none does.

checks.name: Run summary
checks.description: Always reports one info line with what the plugin saw, so you can tell it ran.

checks.name: Word count per chapter
checks.description: Reports the word count of each document in the reading order. Off by default: switch it on to see a toggle at work.
